title: Keep the dashboard open for drill-in after a run has ended
description:
watch draws one final frame for a run that has ended and exits at once, so enter (tick drill-in) and e (feed) are reachable only while the run lives. After a run stops or fails is exactly when a person wants the per-tick attempts, reasons and gate evidence. Consider waiting for q on a TTY when the run has already ended.
evidence: ticfac watch epic-hn6 against the stopped run_08f5 exits 7 immediately in a pty

ticfac run epic-hn6 created this tick by absorbing the finding 3f9660d2383738b9bb743f70022770b47365136dfd5cf1aa7be8d956967a38ae (reported by run-epic-hn6/tick-435/attempt-22): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A3. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-hn6/absorptions/3f9660d2383738b9bb743f70022770b47365136dfd5cf1aa7be8d956967a38ae.json on the run branch.
notes: 2026-10-05 15:11 - ticfac run epic-hn6: created by absorbing finding 3f9660d2383738b9bb743f70022770b47365136dfd5cf1aa7be8d956967a38ae — placed before the close-out, which does not start while it is open; the review had already run. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-hn6/absorptions/3f9660d2383738b9bb743f70022770b47365136dfd5cf1aa7be8d956967a38ae.json on epic/hn6, and it says: the classifier put 0.87 of its probability mass on the items rather than on none, at or above the deliberately cheap absorb threshold of 0.35, and named A3: a false positive costs the epic work it did not need, a false negative closes an epic whose goal is unmet in a factory where nobody is watching, and those are not the same cost — the threshold sits on the cheap side
